subject: Next steps: technical deep dive — slot choices & draft agenda
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Dawson <sophie@bytewave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 15:04:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Next steps: technical deep dive — slot choices & draft agenda

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap from my side:
- Primary use case: low-latency embedding + reranking for search across product docs (~1M docs).
- Target latency: 50-150ms per request (p95).
- Traffic shape: bursty spikes around product releases; steady baseline of ~30 req/s.
- Data constraints: customer PII redaction required; on-prem or VPC preferred down the line.

To make progress, we should schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML + infra folks to:
1) review architecture/traffic patterns in more detail
2) validate model/quantization options and latency targets
3) discuss network/VPC and data flows for the PoC
4) agree on next milestones and runbook items

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed Sep 9 10:30–12:00 PT
- Thu Sep 10 14:00–15:30 PT
- Fri Sep 11 09:00–10:30 PT

Draft agenda (60–90m):
- 0–10m: intros & goals for the session
- 10–30m: ByteWave architecture + traffic profile (Sophie / Carlos)
- 30–55m: Redwood serving model options + latency profiles (Soojin / Karthik)
- 55–75m: Networking, VPC, and privacy controls (Redwood infra)
- 75–90m: Wrap, action items, ownerships

Pre-reads / asks before the call:
- A short document with sample queries and typical payload sizes (attachment or Drive link)
- Confirmation of who will join from your side (engineering, security, product)
- Any firewall/VPN requirements so our infra team can prep access

I attached a short pre-demo checklist we use on our side to make these runs high-signal. If any of the slots above work, reply with the preferred time and final attendee list and I will send a calendar invite. If none work, happy to run a quick Doodle/Calendly poll.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Hi Vivek —

Appreciate the clear recap. Wed Sep 9 10:30–12:00 PT looks good for us. I will bring Carlos (ML lead) and Lina (platform engineer).

Attaching a short overview of our PoC goals and current infra map for context (ByteWave-PoC-Context.pdf). A couple of quick notes:
- We will need to confirm whether we can open outbound access to your hosted endpoints or whether a VPC peering is required for the PoC.
- Sample payloads: average request ~2–3 KB; peak 50–60 qps during load tests.

Please go ahead and set the invite for Wed 9/9 at 10:30 PT.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Dawson
Head of Product
ByteWave

Sophie / team —

Great — thanks for confirming. I’ve penciled Wed 9/9 10:30–12:00 PT. Can Soojin and Karthik confirm they can cover the serving and infra segments?

Soojin / Karthik —
- ByteWave will bring Carlos (ML) + Lina (platform).
- They shared a short context doc (attached by Sophie). Please review the PoC doc before the call; key asks for us: expected throughput (peak/avg), payload size, and whether they require VPC peering or can use outbound HTTPS with IP allowlisting.

Marissa — I’ll send the calendar invite once Soojin/Karthik confirm. Attaching our pre-demo checklist again for visibility.

Vivek

Subject: Re: Next steps: technical deep dive — slot choices & draft agenda

All —

I can take the serving/latency segment and Karthik will handle networking/VPC questions. Wed 9/9 10:30 PT works for both of us.

Couple of prep items for ByteWave (Sophie / Carlos):
- Please share a sample request/response (sanitized) and a small set of representative logs if possible so we can validate tokenization and KV cache sizing.
- If you require VPC peering, send the network diagram and proposed CIDR ranges. Otherwise, a short list of outbound IPs to allowlist will do.
- It would be helpful to know whether you plan to use embeddings-only serving or a hybrid reranking flow so we can bring the right perf numbers.

I’ll send a calendar invite shortly and include a short internal prep doc (network-diagram.png) for their review.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Staff Infra Engineer, Serving
Redwood Inference
